name: com.federicocolombo.pulseengine
description: High-performance real-time telemetry bus and signal routing console (Pulse Console) for Unity, featuring multi-protocol ingestion (OSC, WebSocket, Serial, Simulators), modular signal modifiers, and universal property/color binders.

samples.description: Standalone quickstart demo showing virtual telemetry patching, real-time waveform generators, and dynamic visual binders.
Recommended companion sample pairing PulseEngine with VolumetricSDF for physiological biofeedback sculpting.
